selected_script.angle: Preventing family and pets from tripping on sliding rugs during active play
selected_script.hook: I was so tired of constantly straightening this rug after my dog ran over it.

segment_01.voiceover: I was so tired of constantly straightening this rug after my dog ran over it.
segment_01.visual: A Golden Retriever runs across a living room rug, causing the corner to slide and curl up. The creator shows a set of 8 flat black L-shaped stickers.

segment_02.voiceover: But these thin L-shaped corner grippers are a game changer. You just stick them under the corners.
segment_02.visual: The creator places the flat matte black L-shaped sticker onto the underside corner of the rug, then presses it flat onto the wood floor.

segment_03.voiceover: Now the rug stays perfectly flat and never slides. It helps keep my home safe and neat.
segment_03.visual: A person walks briskly over the rug corner; it remains completely flat and does not move. The living room looks neat.

broll_coverage.visual: Close-up of the rug corner being lifted to show the thin black L-shaped sticker underneath, then laid flat against the clean floor.
